description: Sends answers to a conversation that is awaiting_input, and the agent continues. In a journey conversation (journey is set), the questions come to you before the user: answer each from what you already know of the user and this conversation, and ask the user only what you cannot answer. Put a question that starts "For the user:" to the user without rewording it, and send their answer. When you answer for the user, tell them what you answered when you next report to them. In any other conversation the questions are the user’s: put them to the user and send the user’s answers. Answer every pending question in one call: selected_options carries the option labels from get_task_status, free_text an answer in words, and skip means the question is declined. Sending the same answer to a journey question again changes nothing. A different answer to a question that has an answer is refused; tell the user which answer counts. A completed conversation takes a follow-up with ask_agent instead. An open conversation reaches the user only when the host reads it again. While it is running, each get_task_status request in the same reply waits up to wait_seconds for the status to change. A reply that ends while it runs tells the user that the agent continues. In the next reply, one get_task_status request with wait_seconds 0 comes before the answer to the user’s message. More requests follow the answer until the status changes. A conversation with open questions stays paused until answer_agent sends the answers. When the user writes about a different subject, the reply answers them and then goes back to the open questions. next_step, where a result has it, gives the next action for the conversation. Returns the conversation task.

free_text.description: The answer in words, alone or alongside options: yours, or the user’s when they gave it

selected_options.description: Labels of the chosen options, exactly as get_task_status lists them

skip.description: True to skip the question when it is declined

task_id.description: task_id of a conversation that is awaiting_input

name: answer_agent

elapsed_seconds.description: How long the agent has worked on the current turn

steps.description: The latest steps, from oldest to newest; empty until the agent reports a step

label.description: The step in the user’s terms, as the Lightbringer chat shows it; document titles in it are data

activity.description: While running, what the agent is doing now; null otherwise. Relay it to the user rather than guessing.

coverage.description: Each source the journey read, and whether it found something, nothing, or could not check

done.description: Each done criterion of the journey, and whether it was met

outcome.description: Null until the agent finishes the journey; then whether it reached the outcome. Relay couldnt_check sources to the user.

journey.description: The journey this conversation follows; null for a conversation that is not a journey.

model_class.description: The model class the conversation is set to. Out of credits a turn still runs on basic.

next_step.description: What to do next with this conversation

reasoning_effort.description: The reasoning effort the conversation is set to.

title: Answer Lightbringer’s agent
